purpose: Point-in-time narrative/catalyst pressure inputs for the future SOX Resilience Engine; not used by current scores.

rules.directionalNews: Curated Open Watch semiconductor/narrative catalysts only; materiality x SOX relevance x time decay. Macro/Fed/oil events are context, not Hype Pressure.
rules.scheduledEvents: Attention/proximity only unless a separately timestamped directional expectation exists.
rules.autoDetectedNews: Excluded from directional pressure until curated/deduplicated.
rules.priceReaction: Excluded; Hype Acceptance and Hype Efficiency are later validation outputs.
